All tests pass (`go test`, `go vet`, and `gofmt` are all clean), and only `markdown.go` was modified. ## What I did The original `Render` was a single 90-line character-scanning loop that jumbled four intertwined pieces of state (header level, list count, "item open" flag, "header emitted" flag) and even had a subtle bug — it emitted an extra `` when closing lists. I rewrote it as a line-oriented parser: - **`Render`** — splits the input into lines and handles each with a simple `switch`: header, list item, or paragraph. A single `inList` boolean tracks whether a `
    ` is open; each list item writes a complete `
  • …
    • `, so closing the list is just `
`. - **`applyEmphasis`** — extracts the emphasis step (first `__` pair → ``, first `_` pair → ``, applied to the whole document before structural parsing, same as the original). - **`isHeader` / `headerLevel`** — a header is 1–6 leading `#` characters; 7+ hashes fall through to paragraph text (the "h7" test case). - **`isListItem`** — a line starting with `* `. Refactoring notes are included as comments per the spec in `.docs/instructions.md`. `markdown_test.go` and `cases_test.go` were left untouched.
